newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Great Eagle jumps after spinoff dropped.
newsitem.headline: Great Eagle jumps after spinoff dropped.

text.p: Shares of Great Eagle Holdings Ltd rallied on Monday after the company said it had decided to drop its plan to spin off its office and commercial property arm Tai Shan Properties Ltd.
The stock was up HK$1.05, or 3.61 percent, at HK$30.10 in mid-morning trade on volume of 859,000 shares.

"I think, to a certain extent, it is good for the shareholders becaue the possibility of a dilution effect following the spinoff is now gone," said Ben Kwong, research director at Dharmala Securities.

Great Eagle said it had decided not to proceed with the proposal to spin off Tai Shan because current market sentiment would not have allowed the issue to be priced at an attractive level. Lowering the issue price would have resulted in an unacceptable level of dilution to Great Eagle, it said.
"As the company is in need of capital, it is possible that it can raise funds by other means such as through a placement of shares," one sales manager at a regional brokerage said.
He said it was not surprising to see the share price boosted before such a placement if one was to occur.
Brokers said they expected the shares to remain firm in the short run due to demand for property investment stocks which have been lagging the market, in particular Great Eagle.
